additional_maps.title: Additional Map Servers
additional_maps.description: Run more maps from this installation. Each enabled map has its own CMD, ports and saved world; all maps share this instance's configuration, mods and cluster transfers.

server_name.title: Server Name
server_name.description: Displayed in the in-game server browser and written to SessionName.

map_name.title: Map
map_name.description: Map package to load at startup; use an identifier supported by this edition and installed content.

x-lsgm-suggestions.label: The Center
x-lsgm-suggestions.x-lsgm-label-zh-CN: 中心岛 / 中心 / The Center

x-lsgm-suggestions.label: Genesis: Part 1
x-lsgm-suggestions.x-lsgm-label-zh-CN: 创世 1 / 创世纪 1 / Genesis: Part 1

x-lsgm-suggestions.label: Genesis: Part 2
x-lsgm-suggestions.x-lsgm-label-zh-CN: 创世 2 / 创世纪 2 / Genesis: Part 2

x-lsgm-suggestions.label: Lost Island
x-lsgm-suggestions.x-lsgm-label-zh-CN: 迷失岛 / 失落岛 / Lost Island

max_players.title: Max Players
max_players.description: Maximum number of simultaneously connected players.

active_event.title: Active Event
active_event.description: Select a seasonal event supported by the installed server version.

auto_save_period_minutes.title: Auto Save Period Minutes
auto_save_period_minutes.description: How often the server writes a world save to disk.

ban_list_url.title: Ban List URL
ban_list_url.description: Optional remote ban-list URL the server should load on boot. LanGame will quote it correctly in GameUserSettings.ini.

show_floating_damage_text.title: Show Floating Damage Text
show_floating_damage_text.description: Shows RPG-style floating damage numbers to players.

server_hardcore.title: Server Hardcore
server_hardcore.description: Enable hardcore mode, where survivor death resets the character's level.

server_force_no_hud.title: Force No HUD
server_force_no_hud.description: Forces the in-game HUD off for every player.

spectator_password.title: Spectator Password
spectator_password.description: Optional password for non-admin spectator access.

kick_idle_players_period.title: Kick Idle Players Period Seconds
kick_idle_players_period.description: Idle timeout in seconds used with -EnableIdlePlayerKick.

enable_idle_player_kick.title: Enable Idle Player Kick
enable_idle_player_kick.description: Disconnect inactive players after the configured idle timeout.

no_transfer_from_filtering.title: Block Non-Cluster Tribute Path
no_transfer_from_filtering.description: Adds -NoTransferFromFiltering to block transfers from outside the current cluster where supported.

cluster_id.title: Cluster ID
cluster_id.description: Maps in one cluster must use the same ID and shared cluster directory. Setting only the ID keeps each instance's uploads separate.

cluster_directory.title: Shared Cluster Directory
cluster_directory.description: Absolute directory shared by maps in this cluster, including a local drive or UNC share. Leave empty to keep this instance's local cluster directory. Existing uploads are not moved when the directory changes.

no_tribute_downloads.title: Disable Tribute Downloads
no_tribute_downloads.description: Blocks downloading survivors, dinos, and items from tribute storage.

prevent_download_survivors.title: Prevent Download Survivors
prevent_download_survivors.description: Blocks survivor character downloads from the cluster.

prevent_download_items.title: Prevent Download Items
prevent_download_items.description: Blocks item downloads from tribute storage.

prevent_download_dinos.title: Prevent Download Dinos
prevent_download_dinos.description: Blocks dino downloads from tribute storage.

prevent_upload_survivors.title: Prevent Upload Survivors
prevent_upload_survivors.description: Blocks survivor character uploads into tribute storage.

prevent_upload_items.title: Prevent Upload Items
prevent_upload_items.description: Blocks item uploads into tribute storage.

prevent_upload_dinos.title: Prevent Upload Dinos
prevent_upload_dinos.description: Blocks dino uploads into tribute storage.

minimum_dino_reupload_interval.title: Minimum Dino Reupload Interval Seconds
minimum_dino_reupload_interval.description: Cooldown in seconds before a downloaded dino can be uploaded again.

max_tribute_characters.title: Max Tribute Characters
max_tribute_characters.description: Maximum survivor characters stored in tribute at once.

max_tribute_dinos.title: Max Tribute Dinos
max_tribute_dinos.description: Maximum dinos stored in tribute at once.

max_tribute_items.title: Max Tribute Items
max_tribute_items.description: Maximum tribute items stored at once.

tribute_character_expiration_seconds.title: Tribute Character Expiration Seconds
tribute_character_expiration_seconds.description: How long uploaded survivor characters remain downloadable. Use 0 for no expiration.

tribute_dino_expiration_seconds.title: Tribute Dino Expiration Seconds
tribute_dino_expiration_seconds.description: How long uploaded dinos remain downloadable from tribute.

tribute_item_expiration_seconds.title: Tribute Item Expiration Seconds
tribute_item_expiration_seconds.description: How long uploaded items remain downloadable from tribute.

prevent_transfer_for_class_names.title: Prevent Transfer For Class Names
prevent_transfer_for_class_names.description: One class name per line. The render step adds PreventTransferForClassNames= when omitted.

rcon_enabled.title: Enable RCON
rcon_enabled.description: Enables remote RCON commands, including player-management commands. Written to GameUserSettings.ini [ServerSettings] as RCONEnabled.

battleye_enabled.title: Enable BattlEye
battleye_enabled.description: Enable BattlEye anti-cheat; disabling it starts the server with -NoBattlEye.

exclusive_join_enabled.title: Enable Exclusive Join
exclusive_join_enabled.description: Restricts joins to PlayersExclusiveJoinList.txt when enabled.

exclusive_join_list.title: Exclusive Join Steam IDs
exclusive_join_list.description: One Steam64 ID per line. LanGame renders ShooterGame/Binaries/Win64/PlayersExclusiveJoinList.txt for the dedicated server to read.

priority_join_list.title: Priority Join Steam IDs
priority_join_list.description: One Steam64 ID per line. LanGame renders ShooterGame/Binaries/Win64/PlayersJoinNoCheckList.txt for the dedicated server to read.

admin_password.title: Admin Password
admin_password.description: Authenticates administrator console access and RCON player commands. Written to GameUserSettings.ini [ServerSettings] as ServerAdminPassword.

admin_account_ids.title: Admin Steam IDs
admin_account_ids.description: One Steam64 ID per line. LanGame renders ShooterGame/Saved/AllowedCheaterSteamIDs.txt for the dedicated server to read.

filter_chat.title: Filter Chat
filter_chat.description: Filters in-game chat against the bad-word and allow-word lists.

filter_character_names.title: Filter Character Names
filter_character_names.description: Filters character names against the bad-word and allow-word lists.

filter_tribe_names.title: Filter Tribe Names
filter_tribe_names.description: Filters tribe names against the bad-word and allow-word lists.

bad_word_list_url.title: Bad Word List URL
bad_word_list_url.description: Custom URL for the blocked-word list. Leave the default official list if you do not host your own.

bad_word_whitelist_url.title: Bad Word Whitelist URL
bad_word_whitelist_url.description: Optional allow-list URL used to permit false positives.

server_pve.title: PVE Mode
server_pve.description: Runs the server with PvE rules when enabled.

allow_third_person_player.title: Allow Third Person
allow_third_person_player.description: Lets players switch to third-person view.

show_map_player_location.title: Show Player on Map
show_map_player_location.description: Show the player's current position on the in-game map.

allow_flyer_carry_pve.title: Allow Flyer Carry in PVE
allow_flyer_carry_pve.description: Allows flyer carry while the server is running in PvE mode.

allow_flying_stamina_recovery.title: Allow Flying Stamina Recovery
allow_flying_stamina_recovery.description: Allows flyers to recover stamina while players stand on them instead of actively riding.

allow_multiple_attached_c4.title: Allow Multiple Attached C4
allow_multiple_attached_c4.description: Allows more than one C4 charge to be attached to a creature.

allow_raid_dino_feeding.title: Allow Raid Dino Feeding
allow_raid_dino_feeding.description: Allows Titanosaurs and other raid dinos to be permanently fed where supported.

proximity_chat.title: Nearby Text Chat
proximity_chat.description: Restrict text chat visibility to nearby players.

allow_hit_markers.title: Allow Hit Markers
allow_hit_markers.description: Keeps optional ranged hit markers enabled for players.

disable_weather_fog.title: Disable Weather Fog
disable_weather_fog.description: Disables fog so players have clearer visibility during weather effects.

enable_pvp_gamma.title: Enable PVP Gamma
enable_pvp_gamma.description: Allows the gamma console command while the server is running in PvP mode.

disable_pve_gamma.title: Disable PVE Gamma
disable_pve_gamma.description: Prevents the gamma console command while the server is running in PvE mode.

prevent_spawn_animations.title: Prevent Spawn Animations
prevent_spawn_animations.description: Skips spawn intro animation delays where supported.

allow_cave_building_pve.title: Allow Cave Building in PVE
allow_cave_building_pve.description: Allow building inside caves on PvE servers.

prevent_offline_pvp.title: Prevent Offline PVP
prevent_offline_pvp.description: Protect structures and tames belonging to offline players from PvP damage.

prevent_offline_pvp_interval.title: Offline PVP Delay Seconds
prevent_offline_pvp_interval.description: Delay in seconds after owners go offline before offline PvP protection begins.

override_structure_platform_prevention.title: Override Platform Build Prevention
override_structure_platform_prevention.description: Allow structures normally prohibited on platform saddles, such as automated turrets.

enable_extra_structure_prevention_volume.title: Enable Extra Structure Prevention Volumes
enable_extra_structure_prevention_volume.description: Blocks building in special resource-rich map volumes such as major mountains on The Island.

pve_allow_structures_at_supply_drops.title: PVE Allow Structures At Supply Drops
pve_allow_structures_at_supply_drops.description: Allows building near supply drop locations while in PvE mode.

allow_crate_spawns_on_top_of_structures.title: Allow Crate Spawns On Top Of Structures
allow_crate_spawns_on_top_of_structures.description: Lets supply crates land on top of structures instead of being blocked by them.

force_all_structure_locking.title: Force All Structure Locking
force_all_structure_locking.description: Defaults newly placed structures to locked.

disable_dino_decay_pve.title: Disable Dino Decay in PVE
disable_dino_decay_pve.description: Disables PvE tame ownership decay so abandoned dinos do not become claimable over time.

auto_destroy_decayed_dinos.title: Auto Destroy Decayed Dinos
auto_destroy_decayed_dinos.description: Automatically destroys claimable decayed dinos on load instead of leaving them around for claiming.

pve_structure_decay_period_multiplier.title: PVE Structure Decay Period Multiplier
pve_structure_decay_period_multiplier.description: Scales how long PvE structures last before decay timers expire.

pve_dino_decay_period_multiplier.title: PVE Dino Decay Period Multiplier
pve_dino_decay_period_multiplier.description: Scales how long abandoned PvE dinos keep their ownership before decaying.

allow_integrated_splus_structures.title: Allow Integrated S+ Structures
allow_integrated_splus_structures.description: Keeps the server-side integrated S+ structure variants enabled when this build supports them.

disable_structure_placement_collision.title: Disable Structure Placement Collision
disable_structure_placement_collision.description: Disables placement collision checks so structures can clip into terrain, foliage, and nearby pieces where the server allows it.

structure_pickup_time_after_placement.title: Structure Pickup Time After Placement Seconds
structure_pickup_time_after_placement.description: Seconds after placing a structure during which quick pickup remains available.

structure_pickup_hold_duration.title: Structure Pickup Hold Duration Seconds
structure_pickup_hold_duration.description: Seconds to hold the quick-pickup action; 0 makes pickup immediate.

the_max_structures_in_range.title: Max Structures In Range
the_max_structures_in_range.description: Maximum structures allowed within the hard-coded placement radius.

max_platform_saddle_structure_limit.title: Server Platform Saddle and Raft Limit
max_platform_saddle_structure_limit.description: Server-wide limit on platform-saddle creatures and rafts, rather than the structure count on one platform.

enable_auto_destroy_structures.title: Enable Auto Destroy Structures
enable_auto_destroy_structures.description: Enable automatic removal of old structures using the configured destruction timers.

auto_destroy_old_structures_multiplier.title: Auto Destroy Old Structures Multiplier
auto_destroy_old_structures_multiplier.description: Scale the age threshold for automatic structure removal; larger values delay removal.

only_auto_destroy_core_structures.title: Only Auto Destroy Core Structures
only_auto_destroy_core_structures.description: Restricts auto-destruction to foundations and other core pieces first.

only_decay_unsnapped_core_structures.title: Only Decay Unsnapped Core Structures
only_decay_unsnapped_core_structures.description: Targets decay cleanup at isolated core pieces such as lone foundations and pillar spam.

fast_decay_unsnapped_core_structures.title: Fast Decay Unsnapped Core Structures
fast_decay_unsnapped_core_structures.description: Makes isolated unsnapped core pieces decay much faster than normal bases.

limit_turrets_in_range.title: Limit Turrets In Range
limit_turrets_in_range.description: Enforces the turret cap within a configured radius.

hard_limit_turrets_in_range.title: Hard Limit Turrets In Range
hard_limit_turrets_in_range.description: Retroactively enforces the turret cap on existing placements already over the limit.

limit_turrets_num.title: Limit Turrets Num
limit_turrets_num.description: Maximum automated turrets allowed inside the turret-limit radius.

limit_turrets_range.title: Limit Turrets Range
limit_turrets_range.description: Radius in Unreal Units used when counting automated turrets against the limit.

difficulty_offset.title: Difficulty Offset
difficulty_offset.description: Base difficulty factor affecting wild levels and loot quality; the map and official-difficulty override also affect the result.

override_official_difficulty.title: Override Official Difficulty
override_official_difficulty.description: Override the map's difficulty value, affecting wild creature level limits and loot quality.

day_cycle_speed_scale.title: Day Cycle Speed Scale
day_cycle_speed_scale.description: Scale the whole day-night cycle speed; higher values shorten the cycle.

day_time_speed_scale.title: Day Time Speed Scale
day_time_speed_scale.description: Scale daytime clock speed; higher values shorten daylight hours.

night_time_speed_scale.title: Night Time Speed Scale
night_time_speed_scale.description: Scale nighttime clock speed; higher values shorten the night.

player_character_health_recovery_multipl.title: Player Health Recovery Multiplier
player_character_health_recovery_multipl.description: Scales natural health regeneration for players.

player_character_stamina_drain_multiplie.title: Player Stamina Drain Multiplier
player_character_stamina_drain_multiplie.description: Scales how quickly players spend stamina while sprinting, jumping, and fighting.

resources_respawn_period_multiplier.title: Resources Respawn Period Multiplier
resources_respawn_period_multiplier.description: Scale the delay before harvested resources respawn; higher values mean a longer wait.

item_stack_size_multiplier.title: Item Stack Size Multiplier
item_stack_size_multiplier.description: Global stack-size multiplier for items that support stacking.

dino_count_multiplier.title: Dino Count Multiplier
dino_count_multiplier.description: Scales the overall number of wild creatures spawned across the map.

server_auto_force_respawn_wild_dinos_int.title: Server Auto Force Respawn Wild Dinos Interval Seconds
server_auto_force_respawn_wild_dinos_int.description: Automatically wipes and respawns wild creatures on a fixed timer.

prevent_diseases.title: Prevent Diseases
prevent_diseases.description: Stops swamp fever and other disease mechanics from spreading on the server.

force_can_ride_fliers.title: Force Can Ride Fliers
force_can_ride_fliers.description: Writes bForceCanRideFliers so flying mounts remain rideable where maps or rules would normally restrict them.

use_singleplayer_settings.title: Use Singleplayer Settings
use_singleplayer_settings.description: Apply the game's single-player balancing preset, including taming and breeding adjustments.

show_creative_mode.title: Show Creative Mode
show_creative_mode.description: Keeps the creative-mode toggle visible to eligible players and admins.

use_dino_level_up_animations.title: Use Dino Level-Up Animations
use_dino_level_up_animations.description: Keeps the default level-up animation on tamed creatures instead of suppressing it.

prevent_mate_boost.title: Prevent Mate Boost
prevent_mate_boost.description: Disables the mate-boost bonus that nearby breeding pairs normally grant one another.

player_damage_multiplier.title: Player Damage Multiplier
player_damage_multiplier.description: Scales the damage dealt by player attacks.

player_resistance_multiplier.title: Player Resistance Multiplier
player_resistance_multiplier.description: Scales how much incoming damage players take.

dino_damage_multiplier.title: Wild Dino Damage Multiplier
dino_damage_multiplier.description: Scale creature attack damage; higher values increase damage dealt.

dino_resistance_multiplier.title: Wild Dino Resistance Multiplier
dino_resistance_multiplier.description: Scale damage received by creatures; higher values make them take more damage.

tamed_dino_damage_multiplier.title: Tamed Dino Damage Multiplier
tamed_dino_damage_multiplier.description: Scales the damage dealt by tamed creatures.

tamed_dino_resistance_multiplier.title: Tamed Dino Resistance Multiplier
tamed_dino_resistance_multiplier.description: Scales how much incoming damage tamed creatures take.

structure_damage_multiplier.title: Structure Damage Multiplier
structure_damage_multiplier.description: Scales the damage dealt by player-built structures where the server exposes that value.

structure_resistance_multiplier.title: Structure Resistance Multiplier
structure_resistance_multiplier.description: Scales how much incoming damage structures take from attacks.

dino_class_damage_multipliers.title: Dino Class Damage Multipliers
dino_class_damage_multipliers.description: One rule per line. The render step adds DinoClassDamageMultipliers= if omitted.

dino_class_resistance_multipliers.title: Dino Class Resistance Multipliers
dino_class_resistance_multipliers.description: One rule per line. The render step adds DinoClassResistanceMultipliers= if omitted.

tamed_dino_class_damage_multipliers.title: Tamed Dino Class Damage Multipliers
tamed_dino_class_damage_multipliers.description: One rule per line. The render step adds TamedDinoClassDamageMultipliers= if omitted.

tamed_dino_class_resistance_multipliers.title: Tamed Dino Class Resistance Multipliers
tamed_dino_class_resistance_multipliers.description: One rule per line. The render step adds TamedDinoClassResistanceMultipliers= if omitted.

use_dynamic_config.title: Use Dynamic Config
use_dynamic_config.description: Load supported runtime-adjustable settings from the configured dynamic-configuration URL.

custom_dynamic_config_url.title: Custom Dynamic Config URL
custom_dynamic_config_url.description: Stored in GameUserSettings.ini as CustomDynamicConfigUrl and paired with -UseDynamicConfig. ARK: Survival Evolved dynamic config URLs should use HTTP.

enable_cryopod_nerf.title: Enable Cryopod Nerf
enable_cryopod_nerf.description: Enables the post-unpod vulnerability window when this build supports it.

cryopod_nerf_duration.title: Cryopod Nerf Duration
cryopod_nerf_duration.description: Duration in seconds for the cryopod vulnerability window after release.

cryopod_nerf_damage_mult.title: Cryopod Nerf Damage Multiplier
cryopod_nerf_damage_mult.description: Outgoing damage multiplier during the cryopod nerf window. 0.01 means the released tame only deals 1% normal damage.

cryopod_nerf_incoming_damage_mult_percen.title: Cryopod Nerf Incoming Damage Percent
cryopod_nerf_incoming_damage_mult_percen.description: Extra incoming-damage multiplier percentage applied during the cryopod nerf window.

enable_cryo_sickness_pve.title: Enable Cryo Sickness PVE
enable_cryo_sickness_pve.description: Keeps cryo sickness active on PvE servers too.

resource_no_replenish_radius_players.title: Resource No Replenish Radius Players
resource_no_replenish_radius_players.description: Player-side no-respawn radius for nearby resources.

resource_no_replenish_radius_structures.title: Resource No Replenish Radius Structures
resource_no_replenish_radius_structures.description: Structure-side no-respawn radius for nearby resources.

poop_interval_multiplier.title: Poop Interval Multiplier
poop_interval_multiplier.description: Scale the interval between defecations; higher values mean less frequent defecation.

mating_interval_multiplier.title: Mating Interval Multiplier
mating_interval_multiplier.description: Lower values shorten the cooldown between mating windows.

baby_cuddle_interval_multiplier.title: Baby Cuddle Interval Multiplier
baby_cuddle_interval_multiplier.description: Lower values shorten imprint cuddle intervals.

lay_egg_interval_multiplier.title: Lay Egg Interval Multiplier
lay_egg_interval_multiplier.description: Scale the interval between egg-laying attempts; higher values mean less frequent eggs.

baby_food_consumption_speed_multiplier.title: Baby Food Consumption Speed Multiplier
baby_food_consumption_speed_multiplier.description: Controls how quickly babies consume food.

baby_cuddle_grace_period_multiplier.title: Baby Cuddle Grace Period Multiplier
baby_cuddle_grace_period_multiplier.description: Controls how forgiving imprint timing is.

baby_cuddle_lose_imprint_quality_speed_m.title: Baby Cuddle Lose Imprint Quality Speed Multiplier
baby_cuddle_lose_imprint_quality_speed_m.description: Controls how quickly missed imprint quality is lost.

baby_imprinting_stat_scale_multiplier.title: Baby Imprinting Stat Scale Multiplier
baby_imprinting_stat_scale_multiplier.description: Controls the stat bonus granted by imprinting.

baby_imprint_amount_multiplier.title: Baby Imprint Amount Multiplier
baby_imprint_amount_multiplier.description: Controls how much imprint quality each interaction grants.

allow_anyone_baby_imprint_cuddle.title: Allow Anyone Baby Imprint Cuddle
allow_anyone_baby_imprint_cuddle.description: Lets tribe members handle imprint cuddle interactions.

disable_imprint_dino_buff.title: Disable Imprint Dino Buff
disable_imprint_dino_buff.description: Disables the rider buff from imprinting.

engram_entry_auto_unlocks.title: Engram Entry Auto Unlocks
engram_entry_auto_unlocks.description: One rule per line. The render step adds EngramEntryAutoUnlocks= if omitted.

override_named_engram_entries.title: Override Named Engram Entries
override_named_engram_entries.description: One rule per line. The render step adds OverrideNamedEngramEntries= if omitted.

level_experience_ramp_overrides.title: Level Experience Ramp Overrides
level_experience_ramp_overrides.description: One rule per line. The render step adds LevelExperienceRampOverrides= if omitted.

override_player_level_engram_points.title: Override Player Level Engram Points
override_player_level_engram_points.description: One value per line. The render step adds OverridePlayerLevelEngramPoints= if omitted.

npc_replacements.title: NPC Replacements
npc_replacements.description: One rule per line. The render step adds NPCReplacements= if omitted.

dino_spawn_weight_multipliers.title: Dino Spawn Weight Multipliers
dino_spawn_weight_multipliers.description: One rule per line. The render step adds DinoSpawnWeightMultipliers= if omitted.

config_add_npc_spawn_entries_container.title: Config Add NPC Spawn Entries Container
config_add_npc_spawn_entries_container.description: One rule per line. The render step adds ConfigAddNPCSpawnEntriesContainer= if omitted.

config_subtract_npc_spawn_entries_contai.title: Config Subtract NPC Spawn Entries Container
config_subtract_npc_spawn_entries_contai.description: One rule per line. The render step adds ConfigSubtractNPCSpawnEntriesContainer= if omitted.

config_override_npc_spawn_entries_contai.title: Config Override NPC Spawn Entries Container
config_override_npc_spawn_entries_contai.description: One rule per line. The render step adds ConfigOverrideNPCSpawnEntriesContainer= if omitted.

disable_loot_crates.title: Disable Loot Crates
disable_loot_crates.description: Disable supply drops and cave loot crates.

random_supply_crate_points.title: Random Supply Crate Points
random_supply_crate_points.description: Place supply drops at randomized locations.

supply_crate_loot_quality_multiplier.title: Supply Crate Loot Quality Multiplier
supply_crate_loot_quality_multiplier.description: Controls the quality multiplier for supply crate loot.

fishing_loot_quality_multiplier.title: Fishing Loot Quality Multiplier
fishing_loot_quality_multiplier.description: Controls the quality multiplier for fishing loot.

config_override_supply_crate_items.title: Config Override Supply Crate Items
config_override_supply_crate_items.description: One rule per line. The render step adds ConfigOverrideSupplyCrateItems= if omitted.

allow_custom_recipes.title: Allow Custom Recipes
allow_custom_recipes.description: Allow players to create custom food and drink recipes.

custom_recipe_effectiveness_multiplier.title: Custom Recipe Effectiveness Multiplier
custom_recipe_effectiveness_multiplier.description: Scale the effects of custom food and drink recipes; larger values make recipes more effective.

custom_recipe_skill_multiplier.title: Custom Recipe Skill Multiplier
custom_recipe_skill_multiplier.description: Scale the contribution of Crafting Skill to custom recipe effects.

config_override_item_crafting_costs.title: Config Override Item Crafting Costs
config_override_item_crafting_costs.description: One rule per line. The render step adds ConfigOverrideItemCraftingCosts= if omitted.

config_override_item_max_quantity.title: Config Override Item Max Quantity
config_override_item_max_quantity.description: One rule per line. The render step adds ConfigOverrideItemMaxQuantity= if omitted.

auto_managed_mods.title: Auto Managed Mods
auto_managed_mods.description: Adds -automanagedmods so the ARK: Survival Evolved server can install and update Steam Workshop mods listed in ActiveMods.

auto_managed_mod_ids.title: Auto Managed Mod IDs
auto_managed_mod_ids.description: One Steam Workshop mod ID per line. LanGame writes each value as a repeated ModIDS entry under Game.ini [ModInstaller] for -automanagedmods.

active_mod_ids.title: ActiveMods
active_mod_ids.description: Comma-separated Steam Workshop mod IDs written to GameUserSettings.ini [ServerSettings] ActiveMods.

server_game_log.title: Enable Server Game Log
server_game_log.description: Write gameplay events to the server game log.

server_game_log_include_tribe_logs.title: Include Tribe Logs
server_game_log_include_tribe_logs.description: Include tribe events in server game logs and RCON log output.

tribe_log_destroyed_enemy_structures.title: Tribe Log Destroyed Enemy Structures
tribe_log_destroyed_enemy_structures.description: Shows destroyed enemy structures in the victim tribe log.

allow_hide_damage_source_from_logs.title: Allow Hide Damage Source From Logs
allow_hide_damage_source_from_logs.description: If false, damage sources are shown in tribe logs instead of being hidden.

notify_admin_commands_in_chat.title: Notify Admin Commands In Chat
notify_admin_commands_in_chat.description: Show executed administrator commands in chat.

custom_launch_flags.title: Custom Launch Flags
custom_launch_flags.description: Extra ARK: Survival Evolved launch flags separated by spaces.

game_user_settings_extra.title: Extra GameUserSettings.ini
game_user_settings_extra.description: Raw extra lines appended to GameUserSettings.ini for ARK: Survival Evolved options not modeled yet.

game_ini_extra.title: Extra Game.ini
game_ini_extra.description: Raw extra lines appended to Game.ini for ARK: Survival Evolved options not modeled yet.

crossplay.title: -crossplay
crossplay.description: Allows Steam and Epic Games Store players to join the same server. Configure PublicIPForEpic as well.

culture.title: -culture
culture.description: Selects the language used for server output. This does not change the language chosen by connected players.

disable_custom_folders_in_tribute_invent.title: -DisableCustomFoldersInTributeInventories
disable_custom_folders_in_tribute_invent.description: Prevents players from adding custom folders inside Tribute inventories.

disable_railgun_pvp.title: -DisableRailgunPVP
disable_railgun_pvp.description: Makes the Tek Railgun unavailable on PvP servers.

epiconly.title: -epiconly
epiconly.description: Restricts access to players using the Epic Games Store edition.

event_colors_chance_override.title: ?EventColorsChanceOverride
event_colors_chance_override.description: Sets the chance that a newly spawned wild creature receives event colors, from 0 to 1; 1 means 100%. Existing creatures are not recolored.

force_allow_cave_flyers.title: -ForceAllowCaveFlyers
force_allow_cave_flyers.description: Allows flying creatures to enter caves even where the map would normally restrict them.

force_respawn_dinos.title: -ForceRespawnDinos
force_respawn_dinos.description: Removes wild creatures each time the server starts so the world can repopulate them. Tamed creatures are excluded.

imprintlimit.title: -imprintlimit
imprintlimit.description: Deletes creatures whose imprinting bonus exceeds this percentage. A threshold such as 101 rather than 100 leaves room for floating-point rounding, particularly with custom imprinting rates.

map_mod_id.title: -MapModID
map_mod_id.description: Steam Workshop ID of a custom map to load directly, instead of selecting it by map name. Configure ActiveMods in GameUserSettings.ini as well; any stacked game Mods still require their intended load order.

max_num_of_save_backups.title: -MaxNumOfSaveBackups
max_num_of_save_backups.description: Number of native save backups retained before the oldest are removed to make room for new ones. These backups are uncompressed and created about every two hours, so account for save size when choosing a retention count.

minimum_time_between_inventory_retrieval.title: -MinimumTimeBetweenInventoryRetrieval
minimum_time_between_inventory_retrieval.description: Cooldown, in seconds, for retrieving a player's inventory after death.

newsaveformat.title: -newsaveformat
newsaveformat.description: Selects save format version 11, which reduces the storage and save-time costs of cryopods. Use only when the save requires it; loading official 2023 server archives requires this option together with usestore to preserve tribe ownership.

new_year1_utc.title: ?NewYear1UTC
new_year1_utc.description: UTC Unix timestamp for the first New Year event occurrence. Requires NewYearEvent and an event-capable server build; the event cannot begin before January 1 at 00:00 EST.

new_year2_utc.title: ?NewYear2UTC
new_year2_utc.description: UTC Unix timestamp for the second New Year event occurrence. Requires NewYearEvent and an event-capable server build; the event cannot begin before January 1 at 00:00 EST.

new_year_event.title: -NewYearEvent
new_year_event.description: Requests the New Year celebration on server builds that support the scheduled event. Its default occurrences are January 1 at 00:00 and 12:00 EST; NewYear1UTC and NewYear2UTC can override those times, but the flag is not available year-round on every build.

nocombineclientmoves.title: -nocombineclientmoves
nocombineclientmoves.description: Turns off the server's default optimization that combines client movement updates for player physics. Enabling this flag removes an optimization rather than enabling one.

no_dinos.title: -NoDinos
no_dinos.description: Stops new wild-creature spawning. This overrides all NoDinosExcept spawn exceptions, so those flags cannot restore selected spawn types while NoDinos is enabled.

no_hang_detection.title: -NoHangDetection
no_hang_detection.description: Disables the server's hang watchdog, including the shutdown triggered when startup exceeds 2,700 seconds (45 minutes). This can accommodate unusually slow loading, but later hangs will no longer be detected by that watchdog.

public_ipfor_epic.title: -PublicIPForEpic
public_ipfor_epic.description: Public server address advertised to Epic Games Store clients. If omitted while MULTIHOME is set, those clients use the MULTIHOME address, which must be reachable from their network; a private bind address alone will not support Internet connections.

secure_send_ar_kpayload.title: -SecureSendArKPayload
secure_send_ar_kpayload.description: Enables the game's safeguard for a creature-upload issue. It may affect Mods that interact with transfers, so verify their behavior before relying on it.

server_allow_ansel.title: -ServerAllowAnsel
server_allow_ansel.description: Permits connected clients to use NVIDIA Ansel where the game and client support it.

speedhackbias.title: -speedhackbias
speedhackbias.description: Bias used by the server's movement-speed checks. Changing it can increase position corrections, experienced as rubber-banding, for players with high latency.

stasis_keep_controllers.title: -StasisKeepControllers
stasis_keep_controllers.description: Retains actors' AI controllers in memory while those actors are in stasis, reducing the need to recreate them when players return. This uses additional memory, including when few players are connected, and can be significant on large maps.

structurememopts.title: -structurememopts
structurememopts.description: Enables the game's structure-memory optimization. Structure Mods that do not support it may develop broken snap points, so keep it disabled for incompatible Mod sets.

total_conversion_mod.title: -TotalConversionMod
total_conversion_mod.description: Selects the total-conversion Mod used by the server, such as Primitive Plus. GameUserSettings.ini can alternatively select it through ActiveTotalConversion.

use_item_dupe_check.title: -UseItemDupeCheck
use_item_dupe_check.description: Enables additional checks for duplicated items. These checks can affect Mod behavior and should be verified with the server's Mod set.

use_secure_spawn_rules.title: -UseSecureSpawnRules
use_secure_spawn_rules.description: Enables the game's additional safeguards for spawning items and creatures.

usestore.title: -usestore
usestore.description: Stores character data with the world save instead of maintaining separate regular .arkprofile saves; temporary profiles for new or transferred characters remain until the next world save, and tribe data uses .arktributetribe. This mode supports BackupTransferPlayerDatas, uses converttostore for existing data conversion, and must accompany newsaveformat when loading official 2023 server archives.

use_structure_stasis_grid.title: -UseStructureStasisGrid
use_structure_stasis_grid.description: Enables the grid-based structure stasis system. It is intended to reduce server work around large bases with many connected players; results depend on the world and workload.

use_vivox.title: -UseVivox
use_vivox.description: Enables Vivox voice communication on a Steam-only server. Epic servers already use Vivox by default.

webalarm.title: -webalarm
webalarm.description: Enables web notifications for notable tribe events, including triggered tripwire alarms and creature births. Delivery depends on the game's web-notification setup.

allow_chat_spam.title: -AllowChatSpam
allow_chat_spam.description: Removes the server's chat-spam restriction. Check compatibility before combining this option with plugins that relay chat between maps.

backup_transfer_player_datas.title: -BackupTransferPlayerDatas
backup_transfer_player_datas.description: Creates persistent character-profile backups separately from the world save. Requires -usestore and is needed to restore that backup behavior when running the official 2023 server-save backups.

battl_eye_server_recheck.title: -BattlEyeServerRecheck
battl_eye_server_recheck.description: Requests an additional BattlEye service-status check on every server tick.

custom_admin_command_tracking_url.title: -CustomAdminCommandTrackingURL
custom_admin_command_tracking_url.description: Sets the HTTP destination for administrator-command tracking records; HTTPS is not supported by this option. With an empty destination, records use ArkCustomAdminCommandTrackingURL.txt in the save directory.

custom_mertics_url.title: -CustomMerticsURL
custom_mertics_url.description: Sets the HTTP destination for server statistics; HTTPS is not supported by this option. With an empty destination, records use ArkCustomMetricsURL.txt in the save directory.

custom_notification_url.title: -CustomNotificationURL
custom_notification_url.description: Configures the HTTP URL used for custom notifications through the server-message system. This option does not support HTTPS.

dedihibernation.title: -dedihibernation
dedihibernation.description: Starts newly spawned wild creatures in hibernation mode. Do not combine this flag with -preventhibernation.

dormancy_net_multiplier.title: -DormancyNetMultiplier
dormancy_net_multiplier.description: Adjusts how frequently NPCs enter the dormant state used to reduce network traffic. Values of 1.0 or below also require -nodormancythrottling.

enable_victory_core_dupe_check.title: -EnableVictoryCoreDupeCheck
enable_victory_core_dupe_check.description: Requests an additional check for duplicated tamed creatures.

max_connections_per_ip.title: -MaxConnectionsPerIP
max_connections_per_ip.description: Limit on simultaneous players connecting from one IP address; -1 leaves the count unrestricted. Further connections from an address at its limit time out; Wildcard does not document this option.

nodormancythrottling.title: -nodormancythrottling
nodormancythrottling.description: Allows DormancyNetMultiplier values below 1.0 to take effect by disabling dormancy throttling. Wildcard does not document this option.

pauseonddos.title: -pauseonddos
pauseonddos.description: Requests a pause in game simulation when the server detects a player-originated DDoS attack. Wildcard does not document this behavior, and the flag is not a guarantee of attack prevention.

prevent_total_conversion_save_dir.title: -PreventTotalConversionSaveDir
prevent_total_conversion_save_dir.description: Makes a total-conversion Mod use the default save folder instead of a separate conversion-specific directory. Wildcard does not document this option.

unstasis_dino_obstruction_check.title: -UnstasisDinoObstructionCheck
unstasis_dino_obstruction_check.description: Requests an obstruction check when creatures leave stasis, intended to reduce creatures passing through geometry or structures as they reappear. Wildcard does not document this option.

use_tame_effectiveness_clamp.title: -UseTameEffectivenessClamp
use_tame_effectiveness_clamp.description: Caps taming effectiveness at 100%. Wildcard does not document this option.

use_server_net_speed_check.title: -UseServerNetSpeedCheck
use_server_net_speed_check.description: Limits the movement data a player can submit during one server tick by discarding excess updates. This can help constrain movement-processing load on busy servers; Wildcard does not document the full behavior.

allow_multiple_tamed_unicorns.title: AllowMultipleTamedUnicorns
allow_multiple_tamed_unicorns.description: On Ragnarok, allows players to keep multiple tamed Unicorns while the map still permits only one wild Unicorn at a time.

enable_volcano.title: EnableVolcano
enable_volcano.description: Allows Ragnarok's volcano to become active. Turn this off to keep it inactive.

unicorn_spawn_interval.title: UnicornSpawnInterval
unicorn_spawn_interval.description: Minimum wait, in hours, before Ragnarok replaces a wild Unicorn that was killed. The replacement window extends to twice this value; taming also starts the wait when AllowMultipleTamedUnicorns is enabled.

volcano_intensity.title: VolcanoIntensity
volcano_intensity.description: Controls Ragnarok's volcanic eruption intensity inversely: smaller values produce stronger eruptions, while very large values can suppress the flaming rocks. Keep 1 for the usual intensity; the documented minimum is 0.25, with at least 0.5 advised for multiplayer.

volcano_interval.title: VolcanoInterval
volcano_interval.description: Controls the wait between Ragnarok volcano activations: 0 uses the normal 5,000-15,000-second window, while positive values multiply that interval. Larger values make eruptions less frequent.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: Controls how many seconds the message of the day remains visible when a player joins.

message.title: Message
message.description: Text shown to players after they log in. Enter it without surrounding quotes and use the literal sequence \n wherever the displayed message should start a new line.

auto_pv_estart_time_seconds.title: AutoPvEStartTimeSeconds
auto_pv_estart_time_seconds.description: Sets the daily start of the scheduled PvE period as a whole number of seconds from 0 to 86400. Enable the automatic PvE timer, choose its clock source, and configure the end time as well.

auto_pv_estop_time_seconds.title: AutoPvEStopTimeSeconds
auto_pv_estop_time_seconds.description: Sets the daily end of the scheduled PvE period as a whole number of seconds from 0 to 86400. Enable the automatic PvE timer, choose its clock source, and configure the start time as well.

b_allow_unclaim_dinos.title: bAllowUnclaimDinos
b_allow_unclaim_dinos.description: Lets owners relinquish their tamed creatures. Turn this off to prevent players from unclaiming them.

b_allow_flyer_speed_leveling.title: bAllowFlyerSpeedLeveling
b_allow_flyer_speed_leveling.description: Lets players assign Movement Speed levels to flying creatures. Ascended also requires bAllowSpeedLeveling to be enabled.

b_allow_platform_saddle_multi_floors.title: bAllowPlatformSaddleMultiFloors
b_allow_platform_saddle_multi_floors.description: Permits buildings with more than one floor on platform saddles.

b_allow_unlimited_respecs.title: bAllowUnlimitedRespecs
b_allow_unlimited_respecs.description: Removes the 24-hour wait between Mindwipe Tonic uses, allowing repeated character respecs.

base_temperature_multiplier.title: BaseTemperatureMultiplier
base_temperature_multiplier.description: Adjusts the map's base environmental temperature. Lower values make the environment colder, while higher values make it warmer.

b_auto_pv_etimer.title: bAutoPvETimer
b_auto_pv_etimer.description: Switches a PvPvE server into PvE during a configured daily time window. Set the start, end, and system-time preference to define that window.

b_auto_pv_euse_system_time.title: bAutoPvEUseSystemTime
b_auto_pv_euse_system_time.description: Uses the host computer's clock for scheduled PvE start and end times. When disabled, the schedule follows the game world's clock.

b_disable_dino_breeding.title: bDisableDinoBreeding
b_disable_dino_breeding.description: Turns off breeding for tamed creatures.

b_disable_dino_riding.title: bDisableDinoRiding
b_disable_dino_riding.description: Prevents survivors from mounting tamed creatures.

b_disable_dino_taming.title: bDisableDinoTaming
b_disable_dino_taming.description: Blocks the taming of wild creatures.

b_disable_friendly_fire.title: bDisableFriendlyFire
b_disable_friendly_fire.description: Blocks damage between members of the same tribe and their tames or structures.

b_flyer_platform_allow_unaligned_dino_ba.title: bFlyerPlatformAllowUnalignedDinoBasing
b_flyer_platform_allow_unaligned_dino_ba.description: Allows tames from outside an allied tribe to stand on a Quetzal's platform while it is airborne.

b_ignore_structures_prevention_volumes.title: bIgnoreStructuresPreventionVolumes
b_ignore_structures_prevention_volumes.description: Allows construction in areas normally blocked by map building restrictions, including some Obelisks and the Aberration Portal. Genesis: Part 1 also has the separate bGenesisUseStructuresPreventionVolumes control for mission areas.

b_increase_pv_prespawn_interval.title: bIncreasePvPRespawnInterval
b_increase_pv_prespawn_interval.description: Adds a growing respawn delay after repeated PvP deaths to a team. The base delay, multiplier, and repeated-death time window are configured separately.

b_only_allow_specified_engrams.title: bOnlyAllowSpecifiedEngrams
b_only_allow_specified_engrams.description: Restricts available Engrams to those explicitly listed in OverrideEngramEntries or OverrideNamedEngramEntries. Enabling this also removes items and blueprints associated with the hidden Engrams.

b_passive_defenses_damage_riderless_dino.title: bPassiveDefensesDamageRiderlessDinos
b_passive_defenses_damage_riderless_dino.description: Lets spike-wall defenses damage wild creatures and creatures without a rider.

b_pv_eallow_tribe_war.title: bPvEAllowTribeWar
b_pv_eallow_tribe_war.description: Allows tribes on PvE servers to agree to a war for a defined period.

b_pv_eallow_tribe_war_cancel.title: bPvEAllowTribeWarCancel
b_pv_eallow_tribe_war_cancel.description: Lets tribes cancel an agreed war before its scheduled start.

b_pv_edisable_friendly_fire.title: bPvEDisableFriendlyFire
b_pv_edisable_friendly_fire.description: On PvE servers, blocks damage between tribe members and their tames or structures.

b_use_corpse_locator.title: bUseCorpseLocator
b_use_corpse_locator.description: Shows the green location beam above a survivor's corpse so they can find it after respawning.

b_use_tame_limit_for_structures_only.title: bUseTameLimitForStructuresOnly
b_use_tame_limit_for_structures_only.description: Counts tame units only for rafts and platforms carrying structures. Tames without platform structures no longer consume that allowance.

crafting_skill_bonus_multiplier.title: CraftingSkillBonusMultiplier
crafting_skill_bonus_multiplier.description: Adjusts the bonus contributed by points invested in Crafting Skill. Higher values increase that bonus.

craft_xpmultiplier.title: CraftXPMultiplier
craft_xpmultiplier.description: Adjusts experience gained from crafting items. Higher values award more crafting XP.

destroy_tames_over_level_clamp.title: DestroyTamesOverLevelClamp
destroy_tames_over_level_clamp.description: Sets the highest tame level to retain at startup. The server deletes tamed creatures above this level when it starts.

dino_harvesting_damage_multiplier.title: DinoHarvestingDamageMultiplier
dino_harvesting_damage_multiplier.description: Adjusts the damage tamed creatures deal to harvestable objects. Higher values let tames deplete those objects more quickly.

dino_turret_damage_multiplier.title: DinoTurretDamageMultiplier
dino_turret_damage_multiplier.description: Adjusts turret damage against creatures. Higher values make those turret hits deal more damage.

exclude_item_indices.title: ExcludeItemIndices
exclude_item_indices.description: Removes specified item IDs from supply-crate loot. Repeat this entry to exclude more than one item.

fast_decay_interval.title: FastDecayInterval
fast_decay_interval.description: Sets the fast-decay timer, in seconds, for eligible structures such as isolated foundations or pillars. FastDecayUnsnappedCoreStructures must also be enabled in GameUserSettings.ini.

fuel_consumption_interval_multiplier.title: FuelConsumptionIntervalMultiplier
fuel_consumption_interval_multiplier.description: Adjusts the time between fuel-consumption events. A larger multiplier extends the interval between fuel uses.

generic_xpmultiplier.title: GenericXPMultiplier
generic_xpmultiplier.description: Adjusts passive experience earned over time. Higher values grant more XP from this source.

global_corpse_decomposition_time_multipl.title: GlobalCorpseDecompositionTimeMultiplier
global_corpse_decomposition_time_multipl.description: Adjusts how long survivor and creature corpses remain before decomposing. Higher values keep them in the world longer.

global_item_decomposition_time_multiplie.title: GlobalItemDecompositionTimeMultiplier
global_item_decomposition_time_multiplie.description: Adjusts how long dropped items and loot bags remain before disappearing. Higher values extend their lifetime.

global_powered_battery_durability_decrea.title: GlobalPoweredBatteryDurabilityDecreasePerSecond
global_powered_battery_durability_decrea.description: Sets the rate at which Charge Battery durability is consumed while powering electrical objects. Higher values drain the battery more quickly.

global_spoiling_time_multiplier.title: GlobalSpoilingTimeMultiplier
global_spoiling_time_multiplier.description: Adjusts the time before perishable items spoil. Higher values preserve them longer.

hair_growth_speed_multiplier.title: HairGrowthSpeedMultiplier
hair_growth_speed_multiplier.description: Adjusts how quickly survivor hair grows. Higher values accelerate growth.

harvest_resource_item_amount_class_multi.title: HarvestResourceItemAmountClassMultipliers
harvest_resource_item_amount_class_multi.description: Sets separate harvest-yield multipliers for individual resource item classes. This lets you change one resource's yield without applying the same change to every resource.

harvest_xpmultiplier.title: HarvestXPMultiplier
harvest_xpmultiplier.description: Adjusts experience gained from gathering resources. Higher values grant more harvesting XP.

increase_pv_prespawn_interval_base_amoun.title: IncreasePvPRespawnIntervalBaseAmount
increase_pv_prespawn_interval_base_amoun.description: Base penalty, in seconds, added to PvP respawns when increased respawn intervals are enabled. Repeated deaths to a team within the configured check period scale this penalty using IncreasePvPRespawnIntervalMultiplier.

increase_pv_prespawn_interval_check_peri.title: IncreasePvPRespawnIntervalCheckPeriod
increase_pv_prespawn_interval_check_peri.description: Time window, in seconds, during which repeated PvP deaths to a team increase the respawn penalty. Requires bIncreasePvPRespawnInterval; the base penalty and multiplier determine the added delay.

increase_pv_prespawn_interval_multiplier.title: IncreasePvPRespawnIntervalMultiplier
increase_pv_prespawn_interval_multiplier.description: Multiplier applied to the additional respawn delay for repeated PvP deaths within IncreasePvPRespawnIntervalCheckPeriod. Requires bIncreasePvPRespawnInterval and works with IncreasePvPRespawnIntervalBaseAmount.

item_stat_clamps_attribute.title: ItemStatClamps[<attribute>]
item_stat_clamps_attribute.description: Upper limits for individual item attributes, configured through indexed ItemStatClamps entries. The server must also start with ClampItemStats enabled for these limits to apply.

kill_xpmultiplier.title: KillXPMultiplier
kill_xpmultiplier.description: XP awarded for kills, relative to the normal amount. Values above 1 increase the reward; values below 1 reduce it.

limit_non_player_dropped_items_count.title: LimitNonPlayerDroppedItemsCount
limit_non_player_dropped_items_count.description: Maximum count for non-player-dropped items within the area defined by LimitNonPlayerDroppedItemsRange. Use the companion range setting to control how widely the limit applies.

limit_non_player_dropped_items_range.title: LimitNonPlayerDroppedItemsRange
limit_non_player_dropped_items_range.description: Range, in Unreal units, used to enforce LimitNonPlayerDroppedItemsCount. It defines the area in which eligible dropped items share the configured count limit.

max_alliances_per_tribe.title: MaxAlliancesPerTribe
max_alliances_per_tribe.description: Maximum number of alliances that one tribe may join or establish. This limits alliance membership per tribe, rather than tribe membership per alliance.

max_fall_speed_multiplier.title: MaxFallSpeedMultiplier
max_fall_speed_multiplier.description: Scales the downward-speed threshold for player fall damage. Higher values allow longer falls before damage begins, while lower values make shorter falls dangerous; gravity and movement physics are unchanged.

max_number_of_players_in_tribe.title: MaxNumberOfPlayersInTribe
max_number_of_players_in_tribe.description: Membership limit for each tribe. A value of 0 removes the limit; 1 restricts each tribe to a single survivor.

max_tribe_logs.title: MaxTribeLogs
max_tribe_logs.description: Number of tribe-history entries available for display per tribe. Increase this to show more past tribe events.

max_tribes_per_alliance.title: MaxTribesPerAlliance
max_tribes_per_alliance.description: Maximum number of tribes allowed in a single alliance. This is separate from the number of alliances each tribe may join.

override_max_experience_points_dino.title: OverrideMaxExperiencePointsDino
override_max_experience_points_dino.description: Absolute XP ceiling for a tamed creature. The value replaces the normal cap rather than multiplying it.

override_max_experience_points_player.title: OverrideMaxExperiencePointsPlayer
override_max_experience_points_player.description: Absolute XP ceiling for a player character. The value replaces the normal cap rather than multiplying it.

override_engram_entries.title: OverrideEngramEntries
override_engram_entries.description: Overrides whether an engram can be learned and the requirements for learning it. Each entry identifies its target by the engram's numeric index.

passive_tame_interval_multiplier.title: PassiveTameIntervalMultiplier
passive_tame_interval_multiplier.description: Adjusts the interval between taming interactions requested by creatures that use passive taming.

per_level_stats_multiplier_player_intege.title: PerLevelStatsMultiplier_Player[<integer>]
per_level_stats_multiplier_player_intege.description: Per-level stat multipliers for player characters. Native numeric stat indexes select which attributes receive each multiplier.

per_level_stats_multiplier_dino_tamed_ty.title: PerLevelStatsMultiplier_DinoTamed<_type>[<integer>]
per_level_stats_multiplier_dino_tamed_ty.description: Stat multipliers for tamed creatures, using the native tamed-stat variant and numeric stat index. Choose the variant and index for the specific stat adjustment you intend to change.

per_level_stats_multiplier_dino_wild_int.title: PerLevelStatsMultiplier_DinoWild[<integer>]
per_level_stats_multiplier_dino_wild_int.description: Per-level stat multipliers for wild creatures. Native numeric stat indexes select which attributes receive each multiplier.

player_base_stat_multipliers_attribute.title: PlayerBaseStatMultipliers[<attribute>]
player_base_stat_multipliers_attribute.description: Multipliers for the default starting attributes of a newly spawned player. Configure each attribute through its native index; this changes base stats rather than per-level gains.

player_harvesting_damage_multiplier.title: PlayerHarvestingDamageMultiplier
player_harvesting_damage_multiplier.description: Damage a player's harvesting hits deal to resource objects, relative to the normal amount. Higher values break down harvestable objects faster.

prevent_breeding_for_class_names.title: PreventBreedingForClassNames
prevent_breeding_for_class_names.description: Creature classes that must not breed. Identify each creature with its native class name, such as Argent_Character_BP_C, rather than its display name.

prevent_dino_tame_class_names.title: PreventDinoTameClassNames
prevent_dino_tame_class_names.description: Creature classes that players must not tame. Identify each creature with its native class name, such as Argent_Character_BP_C, rather than its display name.

prevent_offline_pv_pconnection_invincibl.title: PreventOfflinePvPConnectionInvincibleInterval
prevent_offline_pv_pconnection_invincibl.description: Damage immunity period, in seconds, immediately after a player logs in.

pv_pzone_structure_damage_multiplier.title: PvPZoneStructureDamageMultiplier
pv_pzone_structure_damage_multiplier.description: Damage multiplier for structures inside or near caves. Smaller values reduce incoming damage; 1 gives them the same damage scale as surface structures.

special_xpmultiplier.title: SpecialXPMultiplier
special_xpmultiplier.description: XP awarded from the game's SpecialEvent category, relative to its normal reward. Values above 1 increase that reward; values below 1 reduce it.

structure_damage_repair_cooldown.title: StructureDamageRepairCooldown
structure_damage_repair_cooldown.description: Wait, in seconds, after a structure last takes damage before repairs are allowed. The normal delay is 180 seconds; 0 removes the wait.

tamed_dino_character_food_drain_multipli.title: TamedDinoCharacterFoodDrainMultiplier
tamed_dino_character_food_drain_multipli.description: Rate at which tamed creatures use food. Values above 1 make their food decrease faster; values below 1 slow the drain.

tamed_dino_torpor_drain_multiplier.title: TamedDinoTorporDrainMultiplier
tamed_dino_torpor_drain_multiplier.description: Rate at which tamed creatures recover from torpor. Values above 1 make torpor fall faster; values below 1 slow that recovery.

tribe_slot_reuse_cooldown.title: TribeSlotReuseCooldown
tribe_slot_reuse_cooldown.description: Wait, in seconds, before a departed member's tribe slot becomes available again. It applies both to a replacement member and to the survivor who left; 3,600 means a one-hour wait.

use_corpse_life_span_multiplier.title: UseCorpseLifeSpanMultiplier
use_corpse_life_span_multiplier.description: Lifetime multiplier for corpses and dropped inventory boxes. Larger values keep them in the world longer; smaller values shorten their lifetime.

wild_dino_character_food_drain_multiplie.title: WildDinoCharacterFoodDrainMultiplier
wild_dino_character_food_drain_multiplie.description: Rate at which wild creatures use food. Values above 1 accelerate food loss; values below 1 slow it.

wild_dino_torpor_drain_multiplier.title: WildDinoTorporDrainMultiplier
wild_dino_torpor_drain_multiplier.description: Rate at which wild creatures lose torpor. Higher values allow them to recover faster; lower values keep torpor elevated longer.

adjustable_mutagen_spawn_delay_multiplie.title: AdjustableMutagenSpawnDelayMultiplier
adjustable_mutagen_spawn_delay_multiplie.description: Changes the wait between Mutagen spawn attempts. Higher multipliers make attempts less frequent; dedicated servers use an eight-hour interval before this multiplier is applied.

base_hexagon_reward_multiplier.title: BaseHexagonRewardMultiplier
base_hexagon_reward_multiplier.description: Adjusts Hexagon rewards from mission scores. In Ascended, it also adjusts Club ARK token rewards; higher values increase the payout.

b_disable_hexagon_store.title: bDisableHexagonStore
b_disable_hexagon_store.description: Turns off purchases through the Hexagon Store.

b_disable_default_map_item_sets.title: bDisableDefaultMapItemSets
b_disable_default_map_item_sets.description: Stops Genesis: Part 2 from giving survivors the default Tek Suit when they spawn.

b_disable_genesis_missions.title: bDisableGenesisMissions
b_disable_genesis_missions.description: Makes Genesis missions unavailable on the server.

b_disable_world_buffs.title: bDisableWorldBuffs
b_disable_world_buffs.description: Removes the world-wide effects awarded by Genesis: Part 2 missions. To exclude individual effects instead, use the dynamic configuration's DisableWorldBuffs entries.

b_enable_world_buff_scaling.title: bEnableWorldBuffScaling
b_enable_world_buff_scaling.description: Makes Genesis: Part 2 mission world effects scale with the server's configured values instead of applying fixed additions or deductions.

b_genesis_use_structures_prevention_volu.title: bGenesisUseStructuresPreventionVolumes
b_genesis_use_structures_prevention_volu.description: Enforces building restrictions inside Genesis: Part 1 mission areas.

b_hex_store_allow_only_engram_trade_opti.title: bHexStoreAllowOnlyEngramTradeOption
b_hex_store_allow_only_engram_trade_opti.description: Limits the Hexagon Store to its Engram trade option and removes the other purchase options.

hexagon_cost_multiplier.title: HexagonCostMultiplier
hexagon_cost_multiplier.description: Adjusts item prices in the Hexagon Store. In Ascended, it also adjusts Club ARK token prices; higher values make purchases more expensive.

mutagen_level_boost_stat_id.title: MutagenLevelBoost[<Stat_ID>]
mutagen_level_boost_stat_id.description: Levels granted by Mutagen to each selected stat of a tame with wild ancestry. Bred tames use the separate MutagenLevelBoost_Bred entries.

mutagen_level_boost_bred_stat_id.title: MutagenLevelBoost_Bred[<Stat_ID>]
mutagen_level_boost_bred_stat_id.description: Levels granted by Mutagen to each selected stat of a bred tame. Configure the native stat-indexed entries to distinguish this bonus from the one for tames with wild ancestry.

world_buff_scaling_efficacy.title: WorldBuffScalingEfficacy
world_buff_scaling_efficacy.description: Strength multiplier for Genesis: Part 2 mission world effects when bEnableWorldBuffScaling is enabled. A value of 1 preserves their normal strength, 0.5 halves it, and 100 applies a hundredfold scale.
